entities.name: Suderbod
entities.description: Militaristic nation of humans in the marshland south of the Valley of Tamingazin, on Otaria; its capital is Grand Sudalen.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria where Suderbod lies.

entities.name: Valley of Tamingazin
entities.description: Fertile grassland valley that Suderbod long sought to conquer, protected by the Magewall.

entities.name: Berimish
entities.description: Last independent city of the valley, conquered by Tagard Tarngold.

entities.name: Magewall
entities.description: Powerful magical barrier protecting the Valley of Tamingazin from invasion.

entities.name: Magewall Hub
entities.description: Artifact that sustained the valley's magical defenses; stolen by Aligarius Timni at Ursal's urging.

entities.name: Betrayal of Tamingazin
entities.description: Event in which Suderbod's ambassador helped bring the valley near collapse.

entities.name: Ursal Daleel
entities.description: Suder ambassador who manipulated events in Tamingazin and assassinated Tagard Tarngold; he died when the invasion failed.

entities.name: Tagard Tarngold
entities.description: Human leader who conquered Berimish in a coup and was assassinated by Ursal.

entities.name: Bey Lisolo
entities.description: Viashino ruler who lost his position in Tarngold's coup but survived unharmed.

entities.name: Aligarius Timni
entities.description: Wizard manipulated by Ursal with addictive syrup; he restored the Magewall.

entities.name: Karelon
entities.description: Tagard's general who staged a second coup after his assassination.

entities.name: Tallibeth Tarngold
entities.description: Led the valley's people in resistance against Suderbod.

entities.name: Hemarch Solin
entities.description: Suder leader who died when the invasion collapsed.

entities.name: En'Jaga
entities.description: Monstrous warriors sent by Suderbod into the valley.

events.summary: Ursal Daleel helps Tagard Tarngold's coup in Berimish by opening the Splendant Hall, costing Bey Lisolo his position.
events.quote: allowing Bey Lisolo , the Viashino ruler, to lose his position

events.summary: Ursal lures Aligarius Timni to a tavern and drugs him with addictive syrup to control him.
events.quote: Ursal lured Aligarius to a shady tavern

events.summary: Ursal has Aligarius make an amulet for Tagard, then assassinates Tagard with a crossbow bolt from a rooftop.
events.quote: Ursal fired the fatal crossbow bolt himself from a rooftop using a Viashino weapon.

events.summary: Ursal convinces Aligarius to steal the Magewall Hub, disabling the Magewall, then smuggles him to Suderbod.
events.quote: With the Magewall disabled, Suderbod saw an opening to invade.

events.summary: Suderbod launches a full-scale invasion of the valley with soldiers and En'Jaga warriors.
The valley rallies under Tallibeth Tarngold and Aligarius restores the Magewall, halting the invasion.
events.quote: restored the Magewall just in time, cutting off Suderbod's forces and halting the invasion

events.summary: The campaign collapses with the deaths of Hemarch Solin and Ambassador Daleel, ending Suderbod's hopes of conquest.

relations.quote: Ursal fired the fatal crossbow bolt himself from a rooftop using a Viashino weapon.
they have long looked to lay claim to the Valley of Tamingazin
